title: Product identification.
officialText:
Roof-covering materials shall be delivered in packages bearing the manufacturer’s identifying marks
and approved testing agency labels required in accordance with Section 1505. Bulk shipments of materials shall be accompanied
with the same information issued in the form of a certificate or on a bill of lading by the manufacturer.
SECTION BC 1507
REQUIREMENTS FOR ROOF COVERINGS
